# Condition files {.unnumbered #condition-files}

## Purpose {#condition-file-purpose}

Condition files preserve user inputs and display selections as JSON. ACC Magnetometer conditions, Light shift conditions, and Atomic polarizability conditions are independent formats even when they contain similarly named quantities.

## ACC Magnetometer schema {#acc-condition-schema}

The current ACC Magnetometer condition schema is **6.16**. Only this version
is supported. Older files are rejected without migration, as requested for
this sidebar update. Time evolution accepts only its **2.8** settings format and coherent model identifier,
requires all current fields, rejects unknown fields, and limits total time to
30 seconds. No missing-field defaults or historical time extensions are applied.
The removed `show_rate_matrices` field is not saved: the nested matrix
subsection is always available. Auto update is a session preference, not a
saved condition. The removed `show_allowed_only` field is not saved; allowed
hyperfine transitions are always used in reference menus. Other pages retain
their own independent formats.

The application version and condition-schema version are separate. A UI release can change without changing the saved condition structure.

## Safe workflow {#condition-safe-workflow}

1. Enter a descriptive setting name.
2. Save the JSON file before a parameter study.
3. Keep the original file when testing a new app version.
4. After loading, inspect atom choices, pump intensities, detunings, path length, and probe-source mode.
5. Use the matching older application release to open files from unsupported schemas.

## Probe-source compatibility {#probe-source-compatibility}

`PumpN weak` means a nonperturbing detector and ACC's plain `PumpN` means
the physical pump.

Time evolution v2.8 includes four editable weak-probe preset source choices:
`Preset D1a`, `Preset D1b`, `Preset D2a`, `Preset D2b`. The saved optical
fields retain any edits made after selecting a preset. ACC does not list
these presets.

The two analysis pages do not overwrite one another's optical, timing, or
relaxation settings.

Technical details and validation rules are documented in [Condition-file schema](../technical/condition-file-schema.qmd).
